title: Robinhood HyperOS 3 on Poco X7 Pro — China Base Flash

video_description:
Robinhood HyperOS 3 is a China-based Android 16 build for the Poco X7 Pro, and the flashing part is genuinely easy — it's a fastboot installer, so no recovery hopping and no command list to memorise.

Honest heads-up first: it's China-based, so don't expect a full global app lineup out of the box. Set it up, see what's missing for you, and add the rest yourself. That's the trade-off, and it's worth knowing before you start.

🛠️ What You Need
• The ROM zip, unpacked into a folder on your PC.
• The Poco X7 Pro with an unlocked bootloader, ready for fastboot.
• Working ADB and fastboot drivers on Windows.
• A backup — the installer's clean flash wipes everything.

📝 Steps
1. Unpack the ROM into a folder on your PC.
2. Boot the phone into fastboot mode and connect it.
3. Run Robinhood_os_installer.bat.
4. Answer Y for a clean flash.
5. Choose your root method with 1, 2 or 3 — or press 4 if you don't want root.
6. Wait it out. When it's done it reboots to the system on its own, or you can tap S.

⚠️ Where People Get Stuck
• Running the installer from inside the zip instead of the extracted folder.
• Missing fastboot drivers, so the script can't detect the phone.
• Pulling the cable mid-flash because it looked frozen. It isn't — let it finish.

📝 Notes
• China-based build, so some global services may need adding by hand.
• Clean flash is the intended path here.
• If you're new to fastboot installers, follow the on-screen prompts exactly.
